question.problem:
The area of the rectangular field shown below is $2\,400\,\textrm{m}^2.$ What is the value of $x?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195146/assets/9419ae4a3099216109bff99906e5d1724a8f01f61e48e22edc62c0e1b62a1bef.png)
question.worked_solution:
The area of a rectangle is given by 

$$
\mathcal{A} = a \cdot b,
$$

where $a$ and $b$ are the lengths of the sides.

From the figure, we obtain that 

$$
\mathcal{A} = 2\,400\mathrm{m}^2, \qquad a = 60\,\mathrm{m}, \qquad b=x .
$$

Therefore, 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =a\cdot b \\ 2\,400 & =60\cdot x \\ x & =\frac{2\,400}{60} \\ x & =40\,\text{m}.\end{aligned}
$$
